question: Should OpenClaw bundle a 1Password SecretRef resolver that executes an operator-supplied `op` binary with 1Password authentication environment?
rationale: The protected maintainer label and external executable credential boundary require explicit owner/security acceptance even after the mechanical defects are repaired.

options.title: Approve the bounded plugin design
options.body: Accept the opt-in external CLI trust model after subprocess execution is bounded and the dependency graph is authorized.

options.title: Require an external plugin
options.body: Keep the core SecretRef seam but distribute the 1Password integration outside the bundled OpenClaw package.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded plugin design
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in external CLI trust model after subprocess execution is bounded and the dependency graph is authorized.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and materially completed the adjacent Vault SecretRef plugin, making them the strongest available owner for this shared trust-model decision.
